## Model Details

This model is an MXFP4 (mixed-precision with MXFP8) model of [Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next) generated by [intel/auto-round](https://github.com/intel/auto-round) using RTN. Please follow the license of the original model.

- **Quantized (MXFP4)**: routed experts
- **Quantized (MXFP8)**: attention, linear attention, shared experts
- **Kept in BF16**: embeddings, lm_head, vision tower, MTP, PLE, router

## How to Use

### Environment

```bash
uv pip install --index-strategy unsafe-best-match \
    --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/9815732c16ca076c60b65fccd787167d6a9c5328/cu130 \
    "vllm==0.29.1rc1.dev528+g9815732c1"
python - <<'PY'
from importlib.util import find_spec
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download

spec = find_spec("vllm")
if spec is None or spec.origin is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Install the pinned vLLM build first")
root = Path(spec.origin).parent.parent
for filename in ['patches/qwen38fn-ct-ple-dev528.patch']:
    patch = hf_hub_download("intel-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound", filename, revision="b8b636986747fb91193d76a16f6eff62ba5b696f")
    command = ["patch", "--batch", "--fuzz=0", "-p1", "-d", str(root), "-i", patch]
    reverse = subprocess.run(command + ["--reverse", "--dry-run"], capture_output=True)
    if reverse.returncode == 0:
        print(filename + ": already applied")
        continue
    subprocess.run(command + ["--forward", "--dry-run"], check=True)
    subprocess.run(command + ["--forward"], check=True)
PY
```

### vLLM Usage

```bash
vllm serve intel-ai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound \
    --dtype bfloat16 \
    --language-model-only \
    --reasoning-parser qwen3
```

## Evaluation

| Benchmark | BF16 | MXFP4 | Recovery |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| PIQA | 81.94 | 82.26 | 100.39% |
| HellaSwag | 69.27 | 68.32 | 98.63% |
| MMLU | 86.52 | 86.26 | 99.70% |
| GSM8K | 96.74 | 96.21 | 99.45% |
| **Average** | **83.62** | **83.26** | **99.58%** |

## Generate the Model

```bash
auto-round \
    --model_name Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next \
    --model_free \
    --scheme MXFP8 \
    --layer_config '{"mlp.experts":{"bits":4,"data_type":"mx_fp"}}' \
    --ignore_layers visual,lm_head,embed_tokens,mlp.gate,mlp.shared_expert_gate,in_proj_a,in_proj_b,block_inject_weight,ple,mtp,hyper_connection \
    --format llm_compressor \
    --output_dir Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-MXFP4-Mixed-CT-AutoRound
```

## Ethical Considerations and Limitations

The model can produce factually incorrect output, and should not be relied on to produce factually accurate information. Because of the limitations of the pretrained model and the finetuning datasets, it is possible that this model could generate lewd, biased or otherwise offensive outputs.
Therefore, before deploying any applications of the model, developers should perform safety testing.
